title: Enterprise Information Technology Support Services (ITSS)
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > AMC > ACC > ACC-CTRS > ACC RSA > W6QK ACC-RSA
description:
THIS IS A  RQUEST FOR INFORMATION ONLY. The US Government (USG), through the Army Contracting Command – Redstone is conducting market research to identify capable sources and obtain industry input regarding a potential enterprise information Technology support services requirement for the DEVCOM AvMC. Proprietary or sensitive information will be protected to the maximum extent permitted by law. Respondents are responsible for properly marking any proprietary information in accordance with applicable regulations. 

  
This effort will also provide DEVCOM AvMC with an enterprise solution for IT materials not otherwise available through mandatory strategic contracting vehicles. 

  
This is a Sources Sought Notice only. This is not a Request for Proposals (RFP). No solicitation is available. The Government will not pay for any information received in response to this notice.
